long_description.body:
Gibson invented the original humbucking Patent Applied For pickup in 1955. Over the years, Gibson has utilized Alnico 2, 3, 4, and 5 magnets in pickup construction, each grade with its own unique tonal characteristics. For the all-new Gibson ELEV8 pickups, we are, for the first time, utilizing powerful Alnico 8 magnets harnessed within coils of custom-gauge wire to set the stage for a series of pickups that modern players will use to shape and define the Gibson tones of the future. 




The all-new Gibson ELEV8 pickups deliver powerful, focused tones with an intensity that doesn’t sacrifice articulation, clarity, and dynamic control. The pairing of Alnico 8 magnets with custom-gauge wire allows for a wide variety of tones with a tighter low-end that is ideal for high-gain and modern styles. The standard ELEV8 (10k ohms) is available in both traditional Gibson neck and bridge spacings. 



Position: Rhythm
Magnets: Alnico 8
Wiring: 4-Conductor
Covers: Nickel
Wax Potted
Double Black Bobbins
Average DC Resistance: 10k
Details: Powerful, focused modern tones with an intensity that doesn’t sacrifice articulation, clarity, and dynamic control. Ideal for high-gain and modern styles
